source: SEED corpus — hand-derived from the Elixir ColorMatching.WeightedSquaredError doctest (score 0.205 case) and the documented IlluminantMatching.best_match/4 semantics (earliest-wins ties, missing-measurement exclusion). Replace with the canonical generated corpus from viamin/color_matching#111 when it lands; the schema below is the contract the Swift parity test consumes.

schema.weights: Per-channel weights keyed by light_source (white|red|green|blue|lps); a missing key means weight 0 (channel inactive, never excludes).
schema.palette.responses: Normalized 0..1 brightness keyed by light_source; a missing key means UNMEASURED (never zero).
schema.targets: One entry per target vector, keyed by light_source; a missing key means the target has no value for that condition.
schema.expected: One entry per target, in the same order. selected_id is the palette color id that must be selected (null when every candidate must be excluded). score is the winning weighted squared error (tolerance 1e-9). tie=true asserts the winning score is achieved by more than one candidate and the earliest palette entry wins. excluded_ids lists palette color ids that must be excluded (missing a measurement for a weight>0 channel).

cases.name: elixir_doctest_candidate_wins
cases.description: Weights and target from the Elixir WeightedSquaredError doctest; candidate 101 reproduces the documented score 0.205 exactly and beats three others.

cases.name: exact_match_scores_zero_and_wins
cases.description: A candidate whose response vector equals the target scores 0 and wins over near-misses.

cases.name: tie_resolves_to_earliest_palette_entry
cases.description: Candidates 201 and 202 achieve the same winning score 0.02 via mirrored deviations; the earliest palette entry (201) must be selected, matching IlluminantMatching.best_match/4.

cases.name: candidate_missing_required_channel_is_excluded
cases.description: Candidate 301 matches red exactly but is missing green (weight>0), so it must be EXCLUDED — missing is never zero brightness — leaving 302 as the winner.

cases.name: zero_weight_channel_does_not_exclude
cases.description: Red has weight 0, so candidate 401 missing red is NOT excluded and its exact white match wins; candidate 402 has both channels but loses on white.

cases.name: target_missing_required_channel_excludes_every_candidate
cases.description: The target has no red value while red is required, so every candidate is excluded and no selection exists (selected_id null).

cases.name: channel_weights_flip_the_winner_equal_weights_tie
cases.description: With equal weights the two candidates tie at 1.0 and the earliest (601) wins.

cases.name: channel_weights_flip_the_winner_white_heavy
cases.description: Same palette and target, but white weighted 4: candidate 602 now wins outright at 1.0.
